name: Firelet
desc: Ember-bright and watchful, it leaves faint warm prints wherever it meets the ground.

name: Waterlet
desc: Smooth and glimmering, it moves with the hush of shallow water and leaves a shine where it lingers.

name: Earthlet
desc: Pebble-tough and patient, it carries the stillness of old paths in its heavy little gait.

name: Airlet
desc: Feather-light and restless, it seems tugged forward by a wind no one else can feel.

name: Steamlet
desc: A pale vapor clings to it, fogging glass and breath alike when it draws near.

name: Lavalet
desc: Faint molten seams glow beneath its skin, and each careful step leaves a memory of heat.

name: Lightninglet
desc: A small charge lives in its fine arcs, flashing sharp whenever it startles or shifts.

name: Mudlet
desc: Soft with clay and silt, it leaves blurred little prints that dry into cracked patterns.

name: Icelet
desc: Cool to the touch, it leaves delicate frost marks wherever it comes to rest.

name: Dustlet
desc: Pale with grit, it carries a thin drifting wake as if the ground is always loosening behind it.

name: Crystalet
desc: Clear shards rise from its crown, catching light in cold, glassy flashes.

name: Plantlet
desc: Leaf-fringed and sunward, it carries the feeling of fresh growth just after rain.

name: Poisonlet
desc: Sweet-sour and still, it gives off a faint violet haze that warns more than it welcomes.

name: Spiritlet
desc: Half present and half remembered, it appears at the edge of sight before drifting gently into view.

name: Darklet
desc: A soft black silhouette with pale points, it seems darker than the shadow beneath it.

name: Lightlet
desc: Softly radiant, it brightens the air around it with a clean, early light.

name: Bloodlet
desc: Red-warm and steady, it carries a quiet pulse that feels older than its size.
